title: Chromatic Luster - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Chromatic Luster in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A Chromatic Luster. Lightning is the weakness, and the variant drops a Dark-element weapon, which makes it worth doing even though the drop element does not match the fight's own weakness.

sections.title: Where to Find the Chromatic Luster
sections.content:
Location: Forgotten Battlefield.

Availability: Act 2.

Chromatic enemies are optional, supercharged versions of an enemy you already fought. They are not required for the story, but they drop the better tier of materials and the weapons tied to their base enemy.

Bring Lightning damage. Nothing else in its profile resists damage, so any other element is merely unremarkable rather than wasted.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Higher-tier Chroma materials than the base Luster
  • Weapons and Pictos gated behind defeating the Chromatic Luster

Exact drop quantities for this encounter are not documented in the sources we could verify, so they are not listed rather than estimated.

sections.title: How to Beat the Chromatic Luster
sections.content:
Same answer as the base enemy

The Chromatic Luster keeps the weaknesses and resistances of the ordinary Luster. If you have already fought the base version, your party does not need to change - what changes is the margin for error.

What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
